text:
Mia L.: Hey — running the Node quickstart (official sample) against a brand new org that was SCIM-provisioned via our SSO. curl returns 403 with body "error: billing_required, org_missing_payment_method". UI for the org admin isn't showing any prompt to add a card. Anyone seen this with SCIM-created orgs?
Sam G.: ugh, that sounds like the 'provisioned but not onboarded' flow. Can you paste the curl you ran and the exact response?
Mia L.: sure — here's the curl and response i get locally:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-mini-1","input":"hi"}'
```
response: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "billing_required",
    "message": "Workspace 3456 has no payment method. Visit https://console.redwood.example/orgs/3456/billing to add one."
  }
}
```
Mia L.: but when the admin opens that billing URL there's no add-card CTA, just a banner: "Contact your org admin or sales to enable payments" — and our SSO-created orgs don't get a "trial" step apparently.
Jules (devex): hmmmm. We had one earlier where SCIM teams were created with the `org.onboard_state=provisioned` flag and the UX only shows the payment CTA if `onboard_state=needs_billing`. SCIM flows sometimes skip the onboarding webhook.
Jules (devex): quick debugging steps: 1) can the org admin hit /orgs/3456/settings and confirm `Plan` shows "Unconfigured"? 2) open dev console and check for 403s from billing service requests (might be the console hiding CTA).
Sam G.: also check if the SCIM payload included the `accepts_terms` or `initial_credit` fields. Without that we don't auto-show the prompt.
Mia L.: confirmed Settings -> Plan = Unconfigured. I don't have access to the SCIM provisioning logs though. Admin is internal infra team.
Jules (devex): workaround: org admin can use the org billing quick-add link: https://console.redwood.example/orgs/3456/billing/add-card?force=true (internal dev route) — that should surface the card form even for provisioned orgs. Not ideal but works.
Mia L.: thanks! will try. Is this a product bug or expected for SCIM? Need to include in onboarding notes.
Jules (devex): filing a short internal runbook item and ticket — also we should update SCIM doc to include `onboard_state` field recommendation.
ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2147: "SCIM-provisioned orgs not prompted for billing CTA" and assigned to infra-team.
deploy-bot: FYI deploy to console (staging) succeeded for patch 2b3 (billing debug hooks).
Mia L.: tried the force link and it worked — admin could add card, after that the sample curl returns 200.
Mia L.: can we add a message to the quickstart that if you're SSO/SCIM-provisioned and see 403 billing_required, try the force add-card route or contact infra?
Jules (devex): yes, I'll add a short note to the quickstart README and put a one-liner in the onboarding FAQ. Also adding an analytics event to catch these 403s so we can measure how common it is. :+1:
Sam G.: great — thanks for the sleuthing.
Mia L.: thanks all, closing my side for now.
